title: Exact functional fixed-weir law inside Ribasim via ContinuousControl and one-way connector

motivation.v1: Three-point TabulatedRatingCurve falsified because PCHIP smooths the crest kink.
motivation.r2_prediction: Pinned qh_interpolation prepends a zero-flow point, so the nominal two-point table is internally smoothed the same way.
motivation.r3_source_derived_alternative: ContinuousControl with two collinear points is exactly linear; Pump/Outlet physical flow is clamped by min_flow_rate, default/explicit zero.

exact_functional_mapping.discharge_connector: Ribasim Pump from Basin to Terminal; used as a one-way flow carrier, not claimed to be a structural weir object

control_function.product_behavior: Ribasim inserts the collinear midpoint for two-point ContinuousControl functions, then uses PCHIP with linear extrapolation; the resulting target is q*=0.5*h.

exact_functional_mapping.nonnegative_flow_rule: Pump physical q is clamped to min_flow_rate=0, therefore q=max(0,q*)=max(0,0.5*h).
exact_functional_mapping.low_storage_factor: Ribasim also multiplies Pump flow by its upstream low-storage factor. In all frozen Q1A cases the Basin bottom is -1 m and level stays >= -0.2 m, far above the default 0.1 m depth threshold, so the factor is exactly 1 in the tested envelope.

preregistered_method_difference.expectation: Both remain well inside unchanged 1e-8 m tolerance.

hypotheses: C0 has zero physical Pump discharge after nonnegative clamping and matches the oracle.
C1 and C2 follow the exact linear above-crest law within the frozen envelope.
All endpoint and inferred-discharge comparisons pass unchanged Q1A scientific tolerances.
No SWAP surface-water storage state is needed in the Ribasim route.
interpretation_limits: Passing R3 would qualify behavioral equivalence of the fixed-weir law in this envelope, not semantic identity of a Pump with a weir.
Near Basin dryness Ribasim low-storage reduction can intentionally modify the discharge; that domain is outside this Q1A-R3 envelope.
Production design must later choose between exact legacy-law preservation via controlled connector and native Ribasim TabulatedRatingCurve smoothing based on application requirements.
